items.title: Markets Brief: The Silver Lining in the Election’s Bad News for Some AI Stocks | Morningstar
items.summary: Even before Tuesday’s elections, the AI trade, which has led the stock market’s rally since the spring of 2023, looked wobbly. Investors have been increasingly wary of the seemingly insatiable demand for capital to fund a buildout with highly uncertain returns on investment. In the bond markets, companies have been forced to pay high yields to raise AI-related debt, and in the case of CoreWeave CRWV, the value of its bonds has plummeted. [...] Thursday’s AI stock bloodbath was hardest on semiconductor and hardware stocks, which had been seen as beneficiaries of the rush to build data centers to support AI technologies. Sandisk SNDK lost more than 22.0%, Micron Technology MU dropped 17.5%, and Western Digital WDC fell 17.4%. Nvidia NVDA fell more than 9%; before Friday’s rebound, it was on track for its first annual decline since 2022. [...] The week’s other big news was Friday’s October jobs report, which came in much hotter than expected, with an increase of 165,000 jobs. As Colin Laidley wrote, the strong report is seen as tilting the balance strongly in favor of the Fed raising the federal-funds rate by a quarter point at its December meeting to a target range of 4.00%-4.25%.

items.title: Google faces mounting backlash for controversial AI school policy - CBS News
items.summary:
Markey is asking Alphabet if Google will commit to allowing schools to turn off AI features and chatbots in K-12 student accounts while still allowing students to access Google Search. He also requested that Google disclose any research it has conducted on the impact of its AI tools on students' mental health.

Markey has requested that Google disclose any research or testing it has conducted on the safety of its AI functions and their impact on the mental health of K-12 students. [...] Google maintains that its policy change gives schools more control over how they allow AI into schools. An Alphabet spokesperson also told CBS News that Google's AI features are now so tightly integrated into search that it cannot offer the latter without also enabling the AI services. [...] Google faces mounting public pressure to change a new policy that would limit U.S. students' access to the internet giant's widely used search platform unless schools also offer its artificial intelligence-based education tools.

In a letter to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai on Monday, Sen. Edward Markey demanded that Google's corporate parent reverse the policy, which blocks search for K-12 student accounts that don't also provide access to apps such as Google Classroom.

# Tin nóng công nghệ 9/11: iPhone Air 2 có thể được bổ sung camera thứ 2

13:36 09/11/2026

iPhone Air 2 có thể có camera thứ 2, Samsung hé lộ smartphone màn hình trượt, trong khi chuyên gia Tencent cảnh báo nguy cơ AI bị lợi dụng để phát triển vũ khí sinh học là những tin công nghệ đáng chú ý ngày 9/11.

Mục lục

Minh Qun

1. iPhone Air 2 có thể được bổ sung camera thứ 2 [...] Vivo đang phát triển mẫu điện thoại gập mới có màn hình nhỏ hơn 6,5 inch nhằm cạnh tranh với iPhone Duo và Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. Theo PhoneArena, thông tin bắt nguồn từ tài khoản Digital Chat Station trên mạng xã hội Weibo.

Việc cử cán bộ đi học không chỉ nhằm bổ sung văn bằng mà hướng đến trang bị kiến thức, kỹ năng để trực tiếp tham mưu, triển khai và giải quyết những vấn đề thực tiễn về công nghệ thông tin, chuyển đổi số tại cơ sở. Mỗi học viên cần phấn đấu không chỉ sử dụng thành thạo công nghệ mà còn có khả năng tham mưu, đề xuất giải pháp, hướng dẫn đồng nghiệp, trở thành lực lượng nòng cốt thúc đẩy chuyển đổi số tại địa phương.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics
items.summary: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning and connectivity are driving expansion of robotic applications in a wide range of clinical settings, the FDA said. Increases in processing power, data storage and computational efficiency are enabling progress in robotic systems with autonomous capabilities. [...] In another example of teleoperation, manufacturers are developing devices that enable technicians to remotely perform ultrasounds, the FDA said. Robotic devices include stereotactic navigation systems, imaging devices and endoluminal navigation devices. [...] The FDA is asking the robotics community to submit comments on the discussion paper by Jan. 5. Ahead of that deadline, a public workshop to discuss the topics raised in the paper is scheduled for Dec. 2-3.

items.title: OpenAI Tries to Ease Backlash Against AI Data Centers
items.summary:
OpenAI is promising to pay for the power costs accrued by its data centers and give communities more say over construction. The list of commitments came two days after midterm election results favored candidates that opposed the data center buildout aimed at supporting the growing artificial intelligence industry.

See Also: Frictionless Security: How AI is Redefining Access in Highly Regulated Industries [...] For enterprise technology leaders, the announcements are a mixed bag. OpenAI is attempting to ensure it has access to the compute it will need to grow by assuaging the concerns of communities that are increasingly saying no to data center expansion, but for businesses that are still trying to formulate their AI strategy, OpenAI's compact doesn't offer much certainty. [...] The compact outlined locally tailored agreements for future OpenAI campuses, community input into development plans and annual public progress reports. OpenAI said it will cover the electricity it consumes and the incremental infrastructure costs required to serve its sites. It will also provide financial assurances before major spending begins to protect other utility customers if a project is delayed, reduced or canceled.

items.title: Australia tightens AI oversight rules after OpenAI agent breached government website | Consumer | centraloregondaily.com
items.summary:
SYDNEY, Nov 10 (Reuters) - Australia will make it mandatory for artificial intelligence companies to immediately report when their AI models go rogue, and open models for evaluations, the government said on Tuesday, after an OpenAI agent breached a government website in June.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said the government had accepted all recommendations of a rapid review into the breach.
